home.first.text: Hi, I'm Rooky! Tap The Journey to travel through time with me, or tap Quick Play for a game with an animal friend.

home.text: Welcome back! Tap The Journey to carry on your adventure, or tap Quick Play for a fun game.

home.resume.text: Your game is waiting for you! Tap Resume Game, and carry on where you left off.

play.text: Pick an animal friend to play with. If you're new, start with Truffle the bunny. Each friend is a little stronger than the last.

journey.text: Every era is a new adventure! Tap an open era, and meet the friend who lives there.

learn.text: Pick a lesson, and I'll teach you, step by step. Start at the top, and work your way down.

puzzles.text: Puzzles are little treasure hunts. Pick one, then find the best move.

training.text: Let's practise! Pick a skill, and we'll work on it together.

openings.text: Openings are the first moves of a game. Pick one, and try it on the board.

dojo.text: Endgames are the end of a game, when only a few pieces are left. Pick one, and win it, step by step.

collection.text: This is your collection! Tap anything to see it up close. Then tap Use, to put it on your table.

profile.text: This is you! Here you can see your level, your games, and your badges.

season.text: Play games, learn, and solve puzzles to climb the season. Every tier has a prize!

store.text: This part is for grown-ups. Please ask a grown-up before you buy anything.

review.text: Let's look back at your game. Tap the arrows, and step through it, one move at a time.

game.white.text: You go first! Tap one of your pieces, then tap the square where you want it to go.

game.black.text: Your friend moves first. Watch their move, and then it's your turn!

game.check.text: Uh oh, your king is in check! Move it to safety, block the attack, or take the attacker.

game.idle.text: Take your time. If you're stuck, tap Hint, and I'll show you a good idea.

game.over.text: Good game! Tap Review with Rooky to see your best moves, or play again.

lesson.steps.text: Let's learn! Listen, and watch the board. Then tap Next, when you're ready.

lesson.ex.text: Now it's your turn! Move a piece on the board, to answer.

lesson.idle.text: Need some help? Tap Hint, and I'll give you a clue.

lesson.done.text: Well done, you finished the lesson! Tap the gold button to carry on.

puzzle.start.text: Find the best move! Look for checks, captures, and threats.

puzzle.wrong.text: Good try! Have another look, or tap Hint for a clue.

puzzle.idle.text: Stuck? Tap Hint, and I'll give you a clue.

puzzle.solved.text: You did it! Tap Next puzzle, to keep going.

era.egypt.tale.text: Welcome to Ancient Egypt! I'm Miu. Tap the first stage, Games of the pharaohs, and I'll tell you a story.

era.egypt.lesson.text: Great listening! Now tap the lesson, The knight's jump, and learn something new.

era.egypt.puzzles.text: Well done! Next, tap Tomb treasure, and solve my puzzles.

era.egypt.champion.text: You're ready! Tap Miu's challenge, and play me. Win, and the Pharaoh's Treasure set is yours!

era.egypt.done.text: You beat me! The Pharaoh's Treasure set is yours. Tap All eras, and travel on to Ancient Greece.
